## `business.ads_doris_aegis_peanut_anchor_history_guild_weekly`

```sql
CREATE TABLE `ads_doris_aegis_peanut_anchor_history_guild_weekly` (
  `year` smallint NULL COMMENT "年份",
  `week` smallint NULL COMMENT "周数(weekofyear)",
  `week_start` varchar(8) NULL COMMENT "周开始日期 yyyymmdd",
  `week_end` varchar(8) NULL COMMENT "周结束日期 yyyymmdd",
  `guild_id` bigint NULL COMMENT "公会ID（当前所在公会）",
  `history_guild_id` bigint NULL COMMENT "过往公会id",
  `history_guild` varchar(256) NULL COMMENT "过往公会名称，无历史则为「首次加入」",
  `users` bigint NULL COMMENT "人数",
  `user_rate` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "人数占该公会当周在册人数占比",
  `this_week_users` bigint NULL COMMENT "当周加入该公会的人数（join_time 落在本周）"
) ENGINE=OLAP
UNIQUE KEY(`year`, `week`, `week_start`, `week_end`, `guild_id`, `history_guild_id`)
COMMENT 'peanut主播历史公会信息周汇总（当前公会×过往公会）'
DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(`guild_id`) BUCKETS 12
PROPERTIES (
"file_cache_ttl_seconds" = "0",
"is_being_synced" = "false",
"storage_medium" = "hdd",
"storage_format" = "V2",
"inverted_index_storage_format" = "V3",
"compression" = "LZ4",
"enable_unique_key_merge_on_write" = "true",
"light_schema_change" = "true",
"storage_vault_id" = "1",
"storage_vault_name" = "selectdb_s3_vault",
"disable_auto_compaction" = "false",
"enable_single_replica_compaction" = "false",
"group_commit_interval_ms" = "10000",
"group_commit_data_bytes" = "134217728",
"enable_mow_light_delete" = "true"
);
```

## `business.ads_doris_aegis_peanut_gift_receive_guild_stat_weekly`

```sql
CREATE TABLE `ads_doris_aegis_peanut_gift_receive_guild_stat_weekly` (
  `year` smallint NULL COMMENT "年份",
  `week` smallint NULL COMMENT "周数",
  `week_start` varchar(8) NULL COMMENT "周开始日期",
  `week_end` varchar(8) NULL COMMENT "周结束日期",
  `guild_id` bigint NULL COMMENT "公会ID",
  `guild_name` varchar(256) NULL COMMENT "公会名称",
  `receive_top5_coin` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "收礼TOP5：公会内收礼排名1-5名收礼流水合计",
  `receive_top10_coin` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "收礼TOP10：排名1-10名收礼流水合计",
  `receive_top20_coin` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "收礼TOP20：排名1-20名收礼流水合计",
  `both_receive_send_coin` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "同时收送金额",
  `receive_user_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "收礼账号数量（有收礼流水的去重用户数）",
  `total_coin` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "公会收礼总流水（占比类指标分母）",
  `receive_top5_ratio` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "收礼TOP5流水/公会收礼总流水",
  `receive_top10_ratio` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "收礼TOP10流水/公会收礼总流水",
  `receive_top20_ratio` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "收礼TOP20流水/公会收礼总流水",
  `both_receive_send_ratio` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "同时收送金额/公会收礼总流水"
) ENGINE=OLAP
UNIQUE KEY(`year`, `week`, `week_start`, `week_end`, `guild_id`)
COMMENT 'peanut收礼数据公会统计周表（由收礼排名明细聚合）'
DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(`guild_id`) BUCKETS 12
PROPERTIES (
"file_cache_ttl_seconds" = "0",
"is_being_synced" = "false",
"storage_medium" = "hdd",
"storage_format" = "V2",

"light_schema_change" = "true",
"storage_vault_id" = "1",
"storage_vault_name" = "selectdb_s3_vault",
"disable_auto_compaction" = "false",
"enable_single_replica_compaction" = "false",
"group_commit_interval_ms" = "10000",
"group_commit_data_bytes" = "134217728",
"enable_mow_light_delete" = "true"
);
```

## `business.ads_doris_aegis_peanut_gift_receive_rank_weekly`

```sql
CREATE TABLE `ads_doris_aegis_peanut_gift_receive_rank_weekly` (
  `year` smallint NULL COMMENT "年份",
  `week` smallint NULL COMMENT "周数",
  `week_start` varchar(8) NULL COMMENT "周开始日期",
  `week_end` varchar(8) NULL COMMENT "周结束日期",
  `guild_id` bigint NULL COMMENT "公会ID（流水归属公会）",
  `uid` bigint NULL COMMENT "收礼用户ID",
  `guild_name` varchar(256) NULL COMMENT "公会名称",
  `receive_ranks` bigint NULL COMMENT "公会内收礼流水排名",
  `nick_name` varchar(512) NULL COMMENT "收礼用户昵称",
  `receive_guild_name` varchar(256) NULL COMMENT "送礼公会名称",
  `total_coin` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "收礼总流水",
  `back` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "背包流水",
  `game` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "互动流水",
  `panel` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "面板流水",
  `store` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "囤货流水",
  `blind` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "盲盒流水",
  `mt` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "翻倍流水",
  `panel_ratio` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "面板占收礼总流水",
  `back_ratio` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "背包占收礼总流水",
  `game_ratio` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "互动占收礼总流水",
  `store_ratio` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "囤货占收礼总流水",
  `blind_ratio` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "盲盒占收礼总流水",
  `mt_ratio` decimal(38,4) NULL COMMENT "翻倍占收礼总流水",
```

## `business.ads_doris_peanut_guild_anchor_daily_task_stat_history`

```sql
CREATE TABLE `ads_doris_peanut_guild_anchor_daily_task_stat_history` (
  `id` bigint NULL,
  `uid` bigint NULL COMMENT "用户uid",
  `guild_id` bigint NULL,
  `ds` bigint NULL COMMENT "分区日期",
  `hh` bigint NULL COMMENT "分区小时",
  `mike_time` bigint NULL COMMENT "上麦时长",
  `direct_flow` bigint NULL COMMENT "直刷流水钻石数",
  `backpack_flow` bigint NULL COMMENT "背包流水钻石数",
  `replay_new_user` bigint NULL COMMENT "每日收到注册时间≤7天的用户私信回复",
  `new_user_receive` bigint NULL COMMENT "每日平台内收到注册时间≤7天的用户赠送钻石礼物的人数（只计算新用户直刷）",
```

## `business.ads_doris_peanut_guild_daily_stat`

```sql
CREATE TABLE `ads_doris_peanut_guild_daily_stat` (
  `ds` varchar(20) NOT NULL COMMENT "统计日期，格式：YYYYMMDD",
  `guild_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT "工会ID",
  `week_first_ds` varchar(20) NULL COMMENT "周第一天日期",
  `voice_rooms` text NULL COMMENT "语音房间列表",
  `gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "礼物钻石流水金额",
  `luck_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "幸运礼物钻石流水金额",
  `back_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "返还礼物钻石流水金额",
  `many_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "多人礼物钻石流水金额",
  `discos_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "Discos礼物钻石流水金额",
  `discos_operate_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "Discos操作钻石流水金额",
  `discos_match_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "Discos匹配礼物钻石流水金额",
  `back_store_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "背包商店礼物钻石流水金额",
  `lottery_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "抽奖礼物钻石流水金额",
  `guild_user_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "工会用户钻石流水金额",
  `normal_user_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "普通用户钻石流水金额",
  `normal_user_silver_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "普通用户银钻石流水金额",
  `solo_total_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "Solo总钻石流水金额",
  `solo_normal_user_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "Solo普通用户钻石流水金额",
  `income_voice_room_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "有收入语音房间数",
  `other_room_type_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "其他房间类型数",
  `guild_anchor_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "工会主播数",
  `mike_anchor_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "上麦主播数",
  `anchor_mike_duration` bigint NULL COMMENT "主播上麦时长",
  `income_anchor_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "有收入主播数",
  `create_time` bigint NULL COMMENT "创建时间戳(毫秒)",
  `update_time` bigint NULL COMMENT "更新时间戳(毫秒)",
  `special_guild_make_up_money_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "特殊工会补贴金额",
  `cp_game_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "CP游戏礼物钻石流水金额",
  `cp_game_luck_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "CP游戏幸运礼物钻石流水金额",
  `cp_game_many_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "CP游戏多人礼物钻石流水金额",
  `cp_game_back_store_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "CP游戏背包商店礼物钻石流水金额",
  `cp_game_back_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "CP游戏返还礼物钻石流水金额",
  `cp_game_lottery_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "CP游戏抽奖礼物钻石流水金额",
  `cp_game_guild_user_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "CP游戏工会用户钻石流水金额",
  `cp_game_normal_user_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "CP游戏普通用户钻石流水金额",
  `cp_game_normal_user_silver_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "CP游戏普通用户银钻石流水金额",
  `critical_gift_diamond_flow_amount` double NULL COMMENT "暴击礼物钻石流水",
  `bean_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "金豆流水",
  `coin_board_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "金币面板流水",
  `fans_group_join_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "粉丝群加入流水",
  INDEX idx_up_tm (`update_time`) USING INVERTED COMMENT '加快时间过滤'
) ENGINE=OLAP
UNIQUE KEY(`ds`, `guild_id`)
COMMENT '工会每日统计表'
DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(`guild_id`) BUCKETS AUTO
PROPERTIES (

"group_commit_interval_ms" = "10000",

);
```

## `business.ads_doris_peanut_special_user_voice_room_daily_stat_1d`

```sql
CREATE TABLE `ads_doris_peanut_special_user_voice_room_daily_stat_1d` (
  `ds` varchar(20) NOT NULL COMMENT "统计日期，格式：YYYYMMDD",
  `voice_room_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT "语音房ID",
  `uid` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT "用户ID",
  `guild_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT "公会ID",
  `week_first_ds` varchar(20) NOT NULL COMMENT "周首日日期，格式：YYYYMMDD",
  `anchor_ration` varchar(32) NOT NULL COMMENT "主播分成比例",
  `gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "礼物钻石流水金额",
  `luck_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "幸运礼物钻石流水金额",
  `back_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "返还礼物钻石流水金额",
  `many_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "多人礼物钻石流水金额",
  `discos_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "Discos礼物钻石流水金额",
  `discos_match_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "Discos匹配礼物钻石流水金额",
  `back_store_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "背包商店礼物钻石流水金额",
  `lottery_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "抽奖礼物钻石流水金额",
  `guild_user_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "公会用户钻石流水金额",
  `normal_user_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "普通用户钻石流水金额",
  `normal_user_silver_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "普通用户银钻石流水金额",
  `guild_make_up_money_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "公会补贴金额",
  `update_time` bigint NULL COMMENT "数据写入时间戳",
  `bean_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "豆礼物钻石流水金额",
  `coin_board_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL COMMENT "金币面板钻石流水金额",
  INDEX idx_up_tm (`update_time`) USING INVERTED COMMENT '加快时间过滤'
) ENGINE=OLAP
UNIQUE KEY(`ds`, `voice_room_id`, `uid`, `guild_id`, `week_first_ds`, `anchor_ration`)
COMMENT '特殊用户语音房每日统计表'
DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(`ds`) BUCKETS AUTO
PROPERTIES (
"file_cache_ttl_seconds" = "0",
"is_being_synced" = "false",
"storage_medium" = "hdd",
"storage_format" = "V2",
"inverted_index_storage_format" = "V2",
"compression" = "LZ4",
"enable_unique_key_merge_on_write" = "true",
"light_schema_change" = "true",
"storage_vault_id" = "1",
"storage_vault_name" = "selectdb_s3_vault",
"disable_auto_compaction" = "false",
"enable_single_replica_compaction" = "false",
"group_commit_interval_ms" = "10000",
"group_commit_data_bytes" = "134217728",
"enable_mow_light_delete" = "true"
);
```

## `business.ads_doris_peanut_user_guild_flow_stat_1d`

```sql
CREATE TABLE `ads_doris_peanut_user_guild_flow_stat_1d` (
  `uid` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT "用户ID",
  `guild_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT "工会ID",
  `ds` int NOT NULL COMMENT "统计日期（YYYYMMDD）",
  `default_diamond_flowamount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "默认钻石流水金额",
  `make_up_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "补贴钻石流水金额",
  `discos_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "Discos礼物钻石流水金额",
  `many_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "多人礼物钻石流水金额",
  `make_up_money_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "补贴金额",
  `income_money_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "收入金额",
  `update_time` bigint NULL COMMENT "更新时间（毫秒时间戳）",
  `hive_last_update_time` bigint NULL COMMENT "调度时间（毫秒时间戳）",
  `hive_last_update_staff` varchar(100) NULL COMMENT "调度人",
  `critical_gift_diamond_flow_amount` double NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "暴击礼物钻石流水金额"
) ENGINE=OLAP
UNIQUE KEY(`uid`, `guild_id`, `ds`)
COMMENT '用户工会流水统计表（按天）- ADS层'
DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(`ds`) BUCKETS AUTO
PROPERTIES (
"file_cache_ttl_seconds" = "0",
```

```sql
  `hour_flag` bigint NULL COMMENT "小时标识（如 yyyyMMddHH）",
  `is_guild_user` tinyint NULL COMMENT "是否公会用户：1是0否",
  `user_guild_id` bigint NULL COMMENT "用户所属公会ID，无则0",
  `start_time` bigint NULL COMMENT "公会时段开始时间戳",
  `end_time` bigint NULL COMMENT "公会时段结束时间戳",
  `gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "礼物钻石流水",
  `back_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "背包礼物钻石流水",
  `luck_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "幸运礼物钻石流水",
  `many_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "多人礼物钻石流水",
  `discos_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "Discos礼物钻石流水",
  `discos_match_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "Discos匹配礼物钻石流水",
  `back_store_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "背包商店礼物钻石流水",
  `lottery_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "抽奖礼物钻石流水",
  `mike_duration` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "上麦时长",
  `update_time` bigint NULL COMMENT "数据写入时间戳（毫秒）",
  `bean_gift_diamond_flow_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "金豆礼物钻石流水",
  INDEX idx_up_tm (`update_time`) USING INVERTED COMMENT '加快按写入时间过滤'
) ENGINE=OLAP
```

## `business.dwd_doris_peanut_user_payment_stat`

```sql
CREATE TABLE `dwd_doris_peanut_user_payment_stat` (
  `uid` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT "用户uid",
  `ds` int NOT NULL COMMENT "统计日期（YYYYMMDD）",
  `pay_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "累积支付金额（分）",
  `refund_amount` bigint NULL DEFAULT "0" COMMENT "累积退款金额（分）",
  `update_time` bigint NULL COMMENT "更新时间（毫秒时间戳）",
  `hive_last_update_time` bigint NULL COMMENT "调度时间（毫秒时间戳）",
  `hive_last_update_staff` varchar(100) NULL COMMENT "调度人",
  INDEX idx_up_tm (`update_time`) USING INVERTED COMMENT '加快时间过滤'
) ENGINE=OLAP
UNIQUE KEY(`uid`, `ds`)
COMMENT '用户支付统计表 - DWD层'
DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(`ds`) BUCKETS AUTO
PROPERTIES (
"file_cache_ttl_seconds" = "0",
"is_being_synced" = "false",
"storage_medium" = "hdd",
"storage_format" = "V2",
"inverted_index_storage_format" = "V2",
"compression" = "LZ4",
"enable_unique_key_merge_on_write" = "true",
"light_schema_change" = "true",
"storage_vault_id" = "1",
"storage_vault_name" = "selectdb_s3_vault",
"disable_auto_compaction" = "false",
"enable_single_replica_compaction" = "false",
"group_commit_interval_ms" = "10000",
"group_commit_data_bytes" = "134217728",
"enable_mow_light_delete" = "true"
);
```

```sql
) ENGINE=OLAP
```

```sql
) ENGINE=OLAP
```
